name: @psyb0t/auto-linux-desk
summary: Connect an MCP agent to your self-hosted Linux desktop.
description: A stdio-to-Streamable-HTTP MCP bridge for auto-linux-desk at /mcp/. The server exposes desktop windows and shortcuts, humanized input, AT-SPI2 widgets, screenshots, clipboard, recordings, scripts and human handoff. Program tools can execute commands; optional sudo grants container root. Use only for actions and desktops the user has authorized. Run the server separately. See https://github.com/psyb0t/docker-auto-linux-desk.

AUTO_LINUX_DESK_URL.description: Trusted HTTP(S) base URL of your desktop server, without /mcp/.

AUTH_TOKEN.description: Bearer token when the server has AUTH_TOKEN set.
